case_number: 2024 INSC 139; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 786 of 2024)
summary: Bail cancellation without supervening misconduct; reappreciation of bail merits by same High Court bench impermissible; judicial impropriety in bail cancellation based on case merits alone; reliance on Abdul Basit for broader cancellation grounds misplaced; bail cancellation set aside; original bail restored.
legal_provisions_cited: Abdul Basit @ Raju v. Mohd. Abdul Kadir Chaudhary
Narendra K. Amin v. State of Gujarat
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned bail cancellation orders set aside; appellants entitled to bail as originally granted.
